scope: game/data/gu_lore.json entries sourced from the novel

cards.name: 小光蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon explicit five-point-star form and half-fingernail scale; environment is art inference

cards.name: 月光蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon form cues + supplied Moonlight Gu concept reference

cards.name: 月芒蛊
cards.visualBasis: body inferred from canon refinement lineage and threefold moon-blade power

cards.name: 月痕蛊
cards.visualBasis: body/background inferred from canon twenty-meter extended range and unchanged attack power

cards.name: 月影蛊
cards.visualBasis: inferred dark silver moth-like Gu; canon associates it with suppressed primeval essence, while the specific cause of the monk injury is uncertain

cards.name: 生机草蛊
cards.visualBasis: plant-form inferred from nine-leaf restorative vitality grass; individual restorative leaves grounded in canon

cards.name: 力量蛊
cards.visualBasis: depicts canon legendary rank-nine Force Gu from Ren Zu lore; body inferred as golden beetle because canon names and characterizes it but gives no body shape; game rank-one same-name entry is a known identity collision

cards.name: 熊力蛊
cards.visualBasis: beetle-like body inferred from bear-strength name and clan Gu context; honey feeding is canon cue

cards.name: 白豕蛊
cards.visualBasis: white boar form inferred from canon pig-Gu family and permanent strength enhancement

cards.name: 玉皮蛊
cards.visualBasis: body inferred as a living translucent jade-membrane Gu; canon establishes it as the rarest defensive skin-series member and refinement lineage with White Boar Gu

cards.name: 白玉蛊
cards.visualBasis: body inferred as a solid pearl-jade Gu; canon identifies rank-two defensive refinement result of Jade Skin Gu + White Boar Gu

cards.name: 石皮蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon explicit rough gray stone figurine-like body resembling Copper Skin Gu; workshop setting is illustrative inference

cards.name: 爱别离
cards.visualBasis: rank-two identity canon; body and riverside farewell setting inferred from name only

cards.name: 血滴子
cards.visualBasis: canon explicit dark-red bat body: long pointed ears, two pairs of wings (large main and smaller lower pair), no claws, blade-sharp wing edges; feeds on Gu Master life-blood and multiplies

cards.name: 刀翅血蝠蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon explicit knife-wing blood bat swarm led by one male commanding females; four wings with sharp edges, rank-three instance; game singleton presentation is adaptation

cards.name: 血颅蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon rank-four Blood Skull Gu absorbs blood from victims, hovers when full and emits a fragrant blood spring; skull-like Gu body inference

cards.name: 血手印蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon fifth-rank Blood Handprint Gu begins as a small vivid red palm mark and manifests as a huge palm; the actual insect body is unspecified

cards.name: 血气蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon says Blood Qi Gu replenishes Gu Master blood vitality, improves recovery from blood loss, pairs with Wandering Zombie Gu, and refines with Moon Glow Gu into Blood Moon Gu; body inferred

cards.name: 血汗蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon names Blood Sweat Gu as one of Blood Sea Ancestor inheritances; Ice Skin prevents sweating and bleeding and therefore is incompatible with it; body inferred

cards.name: 经血蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon names Menses Gu as one of Blood Sea Ancestor inheritances; its effect can induce bleeding and its inheritance later reaches immortal rank; body inferred, effect shown symbolically

cards.name: 血影蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon names Blood Shadow Gu as one of Blood Sea Ancestor inheritances and records Shang Yanfei obtained its inheritance; body and effect inferred

cards.name: 血战蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon identifies Blood Battle Gu as one of Blood Sea Ancestor’s blood-path inheritances; specific body/effect unspecified, so the armored mantis and battlefield scene are visual inference only

cards.name: 血神子
cards.visualBasis: canon Blood God Son is rank-six devil Gu promoted from Blood Droplet Gu and ranked seventh among ten great devil Gu; body inferred as a single ruby cocoon retaining swarm lineage

cards.name: 血狂蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon explicitly describes Blood Frenzy Gu as formless blood qi that must attach to another object, enables intermittent natural primeval-qi absorption, then causes loss of control and eventual liquefaction; card follows formless attached mass

cards.name: 血月蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: blood-red crescent Gu, ranged moon-blade attack, persistent bleeding wounds and blood diet (E:V1-026936); bone-cliff escape setting is scene staging from novel context

cards.name: 鳄力蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: finger-length miniature crocodile with head, body and tail but no legs; amber refinement glimmer (E:V2-035502); market appraisal setting is staging

cards.name: 骨刺蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: fist-sized heavy cactus-like Gu completely covered in bone spines; effect causes the user’s bones to grow spikes through skin (E:V2-039150)

cards.name: 骨翼蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: Arm Bone Wing Gu grows paired bone wings on forearms, modestly improves movement and especially strike speed (E:V2-074910); insect body shape is visual inference

cards.name: 石窍蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: hard square gray-white die; one-use conversion of aperture walls to stone, instantly raises current rank while exhausting potential and self-recovery (E:V1-034292)

cards.name: 洞地蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five mother-and-child pair links two locations through a two-way spatial passage for transport and reinforcements (E:V3-078492); ring-beetle forms and pictured locations are art inference

cards.name: 鬼火蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-two ghost fire Gu combines with Bone Bamboo Gu to repair the bone battle cart; teal wisp body is an art inference (E:V3-081722)

cards.name: 丹火蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: orange spherical Pill Fire rises from Yang Cloud and is used as a combat core; splitting Gu can multiply its number (E:V2-057866)

cards.name: 火龙蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: flame first snakes outward, then forms scales, eagle claws, deer antlers, horse-like face and teeth as a giant fire dragon; fights the Blood River Python in the underground blood lake (E:V1-032036)

cards.name: 火炭蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: a one-aperture ember Gu enters a black bear and burns its internal organs; insect body is inferred from its charcoal/fire name (E:V4-154990)

cards.name: 苦力蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: Kuli Gu is a rare force-path Gu sought by Fang Yuan alongside All-Out Effort and Self-Reliance; body shape and auction staging are visual inference (E:V2-056860)

cards.name: 自力更生蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon rank-three Self-Reliance Gu healing effect scales with the user’s physical strength and stimulates metabolism; exact body is unspecified, amber loop-form is visual inference

cards.name: 十斤之力蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-two Ten Jin Strength Gu increases the user’s strength by ten jin; beetle body and weight grooves are visual inference (E:V3-081748)

cards.name: 群力蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Group Strength Gu is represented by an ancient recipe and is extinct in the current era; beetle form and animal-force echoes are visualization inference (E:V4-125666)

cards.name: 点金蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Point Gold Gu manifests as a little golden hand and turns struck life or matter into lifeless gold statues (E:V2-069422; E:V4-070364-070368)

cards.name: 金龙蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-four Golden Dragon Gu manifests as a four-clawed golden dragon; worm-like core with head and claws is described later (E:V2-069222; E:V4-215032)

cards.name: 金罡蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-three Golden Canopy Gu condenses golden radiance into defensive light armor; visual Gu beetle and wolf-siege staging are inference (E:V2-055508)

cards.name: 赤铁舍利蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: Red Iron Relic Gu is rank two, only effective on rank-two Gu Masters, and raises one minor cultivation stage; scene of its auction and orb body details are staging/inference (E:V1-018066)

cards.name: 青铜舍利蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-one Bronze Relic Gu is a fingertip-sized round Gu and advances rank-one cultivation by one minor stage; Gu body detail is inferred (E:V1-018066)

cards.name: 雷翼蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-three Thunder Wings Gu lives on the back like two lightning tattoos and condenses paired lightning wings for brief flight; the moth-like core is visual inference. Wolf-tide battlefield is context (E:V1-027304).

cards.name: 希望蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon Hope Gu is a very dim tiny point of light that blooms with immense brightness when the heart is entrusted to it; light-mote form follows canon, surrounding wilderness is visual staging

cards.name: 大侠蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Hero Gu transforms into a person; the text shows it manifesting as a teacher figure, and later says profession Gu can become people. The Gu-body mechanism is visual inference; alley activation is scene context (E:V5-363292; E:V5-385242).

cards.name: 毒誓蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-three Poison Oath Gu is a finger-sized purple-red insect with vicious mouthparts; it absorbs the heart blood of both parties and, when successful, bursts into red motes that bind the oath (E:V2-049768).

cards.name: 太光蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Taiguang Gu releases ancient suns glory; the light has no direct attack power but passes through every barrier and illuminates a blessed land. Solar-moth body is visual inference; portal scene is Three Kings Blessed Land context (E:V2-072028).

cards.name: 星芽蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon confirms rank-three Star Bud Gu can arise naturally in an unusual blessed-land ecosystem; its seed-pod body and terrarium presentation are visual inference

cards.name: 星萤蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon explicit tiny firefly-scale body emitting true blue starlight; used in numbers to sustain Star Gate and die gradually under the burden; interior gate chamber is a grounded scene choice

cards.name: 察运蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five luck-path scouting Gu reveals fortune invisible to ordinary sight; its insect body is visual inference. Ascension-cloud auras stage the fortune it reveals (E:V3-113096).

cards.name: 风气蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-four Wind Custom Gu is a natural Gu shaped like a cyan-blue butterfly; each wingbeat produces diamond-like star glints, and it instills a shared habit or fashion in a group (E:V2-057022).

cards.name: 奴隶蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Slave Gu can control a rank-five Gu Master once implanted and is exceptionally rare; the insect body and soul-thread are visual inference (E:V1-002640; E:V3-071718).

cards.name: 驭兽蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-four Beast Taming Gu can control a ten-thousand-beast king; its body is visual inference, and the pictured horned beast is staging rather than a named canon species (E:V3-083834).

cards.name: 驭犬蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-one Dog Taming Gu is thumb-sized, jade-like, and shaped like a dog head; it flashes into a wild dog soul without harming the body, making the dog obedient (E:V2-060300; E:V2-064434).

cards.name: 驭狼蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: the L0 ruling sets this Wolf Taming Gu to rank two despite the game ID rank. The Gu bursts into light smoke, covers a weakened camel wolf, enters its body, and makes it submit; insect body is visual inference (E:V3-078942; E:V3-080726).

cards.name: 剑气蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: wild rank-four Sword Qi Gu is found in Sword Break Valley; Sword Qi emits pale, semi-transparent piercing energy that can be checked by hard defense. Sword-moth body is visual inference (E:V5-195606; E:V5-190380).

cards.name: 剑鞘蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Sword Sheath Gu is black, rough, palm-sized, and resembles a miniature iron sword scabbard; a wild sword-path Gu flies into it in Sword Break Valley (E:V5-195650).

cards.name: 水瀑蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-four Waterfall Gu condenses water vapor into a huge, fast torrent that falls like a waterfall and sweeps through wolf groups near Moonlight Lake; insect body is visual inference (E:V3-087006).

cards.name: 冰肌蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-three Ice Skin Gu permanently transforms the user skin into exceptionally defensive ice skin and stops sweat and bleeding; insect body and crystalline surface pattern are visual inference (E:V1-023066).

cards.name: 浪迹江湖蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Water-path Wandering Jianghu Gu belongs to a movement series and lets its user walk swiftly across water; insect body is visual inference. The bridge-and-river setting is illustrative staging (E:V4-154944).

cards.name: 龙行虎步蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-four Dragon Walk Tiger Stride Gu greatly increases running speed and adds collision force; the Gu body and motion-mark imagery are visual inference, staged in the black-stone arena duel (E:V2-059088).

cards.name: 风虎云龙蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: rank-five Wind Tiger Cloud Dragon Gu condenses wind into tigers and cloud into dragons that charge battlefield forces; the Gu body is visual inference, while the wind-tiger/cloud-dragon forms are canon effects (E:V3-107018).

cards.name: 木魅蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: Qing Shu’s tree-spirit complete form, vitality, ice-coffin break and wooden prison (E:V1-023550); cicada-beetle Gu body is visual inference, not stated canon

cards.name: 草傀蛊
cards.visualBasis: canon: the L0 ruling sets this Grass Puppet Gu to rank one despite the game ID rank. The one-turn Gu served as a target for Moon Blade practice at the Gu Yue academy; grass-effigy form and seed-like core are visual inference (E:V2-067080).
